newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 660 retail money market mutual funds fell $1.23 billion to $603.40 billion in the week ended Nov. 26, the Investment Company Institute said Friday.

The industry trade group said assets of the 403 taxable money market funds in the retail category fell $775.2 million to $492.41 billion, while assets of the 257 tax-exempt funds decreased $456.6 million to $110.99 billion.

It said assets of the 308 institutional money market funds fell $1.99 billion to $291.44 billion. Of these, the 247 taxable money market fund assets decreased $1.15 billion to $262.20 billion, and assets of the 61 tax exempt funds fell $839.3 million to $29.24 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $894.84 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended Nov. 20 were revised to $898.06 billion from $898.17 billion.
